data.exact_reserve_text: Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience. The underwriting loss of GBP 151,717k, analysed below, comprises adverse movements on all underwriting years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Uncertainty over Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves led to strengthening of liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year prior to RITC.

named_events.loss_description: Liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k prior to the external RITC transaction.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported significant adverse reserve development in 2016 and strengthened reserves across prior years. Gross claims outstanding increased materially, driven by adverse development across multiple underwriting years (notably older years including 2011-2014) and specific issues such as Italian Public Hospitals medical malpractice (2007). The movement has been calculated from the gross claims development table and indicates a substantial gross prior-year strengthening, with reinsurance recoveries and adverse claim development being the primary drivers.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) excluding the aggregated 'Before 2011' column and excluding the two most recent underwriting years, per the prescribed methodology. The syndicate experienced RITC transactions (notably closure/transfer activity for 2007 and RITC entries referenced elsewhere) which can distort development patterns; care was taken to exclude aggregated 'before' columns, but RITC effects may still influence the triangle. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' single-line note was found; therefore the triangle was used as the primary source. If a gross movement note exists elsewhere, it was not located; some narrative figures quoted in the report are net of reinsurance and were not used as the primary PYD metric.
